button: ONE user button, devicetree alias sw0. Press starts a conversation; second press ends it. It is also pokable over J-Link for testing.
led: ONE LED, alias led0. Currently signals recording, stays solid while agent audio is buffered, and flashes error codes.
buses: GPIO, I2C, SPI and I2S all enabled (prj.conf). I2C and SPI are FREE — nothing is attached to them today.
caution: There is exactly one I2S peripheral and it runs full duplex (mic in + speaker out) with byte-identical TX/RX config. Any new audio path must share it.
status: PROTOTYPE. This is a Nordic development kit, not the product. Every choice here — the SoC, the RAM, the single button, the single LED, the enclosure — is provisional and can change. Design the device the owner should wear, then say what it would take to build it.
you_are_here: You run on the owner's MacBook (unified). Every device described here is REMOTE to you — you are not running on the pendant or the ESP32.
